operation_id_rule: Generate a fresh operation ID for the bounded RF batch at start
route_rule: GPIO20; reconcile the current route through the existing bridge
start_procedure: Supply the existing RP1 development confirmation for the fresh operation, keep local Enable false during managed restart
Refresh saved Fleet state; do not automatically enable any output
At the explicit RF start, enable the selected remote schedules and local WSPR on the same two-minute UTC boundary
Disable local output after the complete 110.592-second frame; pause and stop each remote output at the end of the bounded batch
stop_procedure: Set local Operation.Transmit=false through the guarded HTTP API
Pause and stop each remote assignment; verify known-off terminal state and ownership release
Leave uncertain outputs paused and reconcile explicitly; do not resubmit consumed slots
authorization: RF test and Pi service/state configuration authorized in this session; no RF started during preparation
